correctness.rationale: The fixed-edge joint-edge probability is (m)_j/(N)_j. Exhaustive overlap partition gives exact E(TS) and E(T²), with W=S−3T. Subtracting products yields the factored all-parameter covariance; its bracket is positive for n≥5, and equals 24−4m for n=4. The strict interval and exceptional zeros follow, while leading-order expansion and substitution q_j→p^j yield the contrasting formulas. The included exact-rational checker tests 7,845 cases, including exhaustive graphs on up to six vertices. These finite checks corroborate but do not prove the universal result.

originality.rationale: Originality is scoped to the complete strict all-integer G(n,m) sign classification for the joint triangle and induced-open-triad counts, and the G(n,p) sign contrast, not to elementary overlap counting. Material read of Reinert–Röllin, Dey–Terlov, and Goldschmidt–Griffiths–Scott shows close joint-statistic frameworks without an explicit equivalent sign theorem. The broad Janson 1990 induced-subgraph analysis is incompletely accessible, leaving a genuine implicit-coverage risk. Negative query returns do not themselves prove uniqueness.
residual_risks: Janson (1990) and associated general orthogonal decompositions may implicitly yield the finite covariance and sign; full text comparison was not completed.
General conditional moments in Dey–Terlov may imply the displayed formula after specialization even without explicitly giving the full sign classification.
Semantic search is not a completeness certificate for historical literature or other unpublished work.

value.rationale: Open three-vertex paths and triangles are respectively unclosed and closed connected three-node network motifs, the numerator/denominator building blocks of many local transitivity summaries. The complete all-size, all-edge-count strict negative covariance classification, its nonzero dense limiting profile, and exact opposing G(n,p) phase diagram explain how fixing network density reverses the apparent association. The distinction is useful for motif covariance interpretation and calibration and is not an arbitrary finite parameter selection.
